prompt: Some people believe that professionals, such as doctors and engineers, should be required to work in the country where they did their training. Others believe they should be free to work in another country if they wish. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Nowadays, many people believe that occupations such as doctors and engineers who demand formal professional training should work in the country where they did their training. However, I think everyone has the freedom to choose where they work. So, I believe that they should be free to work in another country if they wish.

On the one hand, doctors and engineers allow to choose where they work brings several benefits for both workers and this country. Firstly, free in to choose country helps meet needs of workers, such as higher salaries, better working conditions, a higher standard of living, or simply they want to live close to their family. When they are satisfied with their working environments, they can work more effectively and contribute more to society. Secondly, this movement helps decrease employment pressure in major cities. In many development country, big cities are overcrowded with job seekers, leading to severe competition. If some professionals choose to work in other city, it reduces the pressure on local job markets and infrastructure.

On the other hand, the movement of many skilled workers can create a shortage of experts in their home countries. To solve this issue, governments should adopt better benefit policies to keep high-performing workers instead of forcing them to stay. For instance, offering higher wages, modern working equipment, and clear career development paths will encourage doctors and engineers to remain and work for their nation voluntarily.

In conclusion, freedom to choose where to work give more benefits as meets the needs of workers and decreases employment pressure in major city. However, the government should adopt better benefits policies to keep high-performing workers.
